Replace Object.assign(player, save.player) with sanitizePlayerSave; use restoreSlice for all campaign slices; add dirty-guard to postRequestSync
Route REQUEST_SYNC handler through queueFrameRender instead of direct updatePlayerUI call
Extract paintRealmBody, register/unregister campaignListeners in mount/unmount for live updates
Add DPR scaling (devicePixelRatio) and Pointer Events (pointerdown/move/up) for touch support; escape HTML at sink for colonist names
Add inventoryDigest and colonyDigest to autosave signature to capture paused mutations
Extend signature to include inventoryDigest and colonyDigest fields
Fix ensure() to return AudioContext | null; gate ambient timer on document.visibilityState and master gain
Verify coalescing logic for PLAYER_SYNC, COLONY_SYNC, REQUEST_SYNC; ensure single rAF flush
Add table-driven tests for malformed player fields (string, NaN, -1, Infinity, null)
Add table-driven tests for malformed experiments/realm/settlements/blacksmith/paddock slices
Test REQUEST_SYNC dirty-guard: quiet when unchanged, posts once on change
Test Realm window live refresh on REALM_SYNC and listener cleanup on unmount
Test autosave captures inventory/colony changes while paused
Test canvas backing store uses devicePixelRatio and pointer events work
Escape log entries at sink to prevent HTML injection from save-derived strings
Remove dead satiety field or wire it to food consumption; remove dead epilogueSeen from autosave
Change video preload from 'auto' to 'metadata'; load video after idle callback
Optimize media output: drop MP4 where WebM sufficient, generate 720p variants
